studies.title: Radiocarbon dating
studies.caption: Willard Libby shows that the decay of carbon-14 can date bones, wood and charcoal.
studies.prompt: Close1949 laboratory workbench, scientist handling a small charcoal sample beside glass vacuum lines, valves and shielded radiation counting apparatus, analog meter. Quiet practical scene, no dinosaur bones or glowing radioactive objects, no modern mass spectrometer.
